description: Enabling Floating increases dock surface height to include the 8px gap between the bottom panel and screen edge.

assertions.comment: With Floating=true, the dock requests a 108px surface: a 64px panel, 36px top space, and 8px bottom gap
The unnamed panel path (0/0/2) is at y=36 on the 108px surface, leaving 8px below
The visible panel height is 64px: IconSize 48px plus 16px padding
The Floating panel corners are rounded with the default CornerRadius of 12px
